scenarios.name: delete-current
scenarios.why: SELECT +0: the COMMAREA filled from the row ('Y', fail code space), DELETE +0, PROCTRAN 'ODA' row: sort code, account, ref EIBTASKN, date DD.MM.YYYY and time HHMMSS from the case clock, the description customer/type/last and next statement dates, amount = the actual balance (1200.00, not the available)

scenarios.name: delete-loan-negative
scenarios.why: type LOAN: a negative balance into PROCTRAN_AMOUNT and the signed COMMAREA balances

scenarios.name: delete-mortgage
scenarios.why: type MORTGAGE, a large negative balance

scenarios.name: delete-max-values-leap-days
scenarios.why: rate 9999.99, overdraft 99999999, available 9999999999.99 and actual -9999999999.99 (PROCTRAN_AMOUNT at the DECIMAL(12,2) limit); opened, last and next statement on 29 February

scenarios.name: overdraft-past-picture
scenarios.why: INTEGER overdraft 123456789 through S9(9) COMP into 9(8): the high-order digit is lost; statement dates across a year end; amount 0.01

scenarios.name: account-zero
scenarios.why: boundary: account number 00000000 is read and deleted

scenarios.name: account-99999999
scenarios.why: boundary: the largest DELACC-ACCNO; DELACC has no sentinel (INQACC's 99999999), the account is deleted

scenarios.name: not-found
scenarios.why: SELECT INTO no row: SQLCODE +100, 'N' '1', no DELETE, no PROCTRAN row; the rest of the COMMAREA untouched

scenarios.name: other-sort-code-not-found
scenarios.why: account 00000010 exists only under sort code 123456; the program reads by its own SORTCODE (987654): +100, 'N' '1', the 123456 row not deleted

scenarios.name: null-statement-date
scenarios.why: ACCOUNT_LAST_STATEMENT NULL with no indicator: SELECT -305, ABNDINFO filled (no LINK), ABEND HRAC; no DELETE, no PROCTRAN

notes: CBSA's delete-account service (DELACC, LINKed by BNK1DAC with its PARMS-SUBPGM record, the DELACC copybook's layout under the caller's names: the generated DTO is the caller's). The account is read by the program's own sort code (987654) and the COMMAREA's account number with a SELECT INTO from ACCOUNT; +100 gives DEL-SUCCESS 'N', DEL-FAIL-CD '1'; any other non-zero SQLCODE (e.g. -305, a NULL date with no indicator) fills ABNDINFO and ABENDs HRAC (no LINK). On +0 the COMMAREA is filled from the row, the row DELETEd (a failure gives 'N' '3') and a PROCTRAN row INSERTed: type 'ODA', the description customer/type/last and next statement dates, amount the actual balance, date DD.MM.YYYY and time HHMMSS from the case clock (ASKTIME/FORMATTIME), ref EIBTASKN. An INSERT failure LINKs ABNDPROC and ABENDs HWPT. ACCOUNT and PROCTRAN are compared after every scenario.
